purpose: Enrolment policy for the BLACKWAVE OTA manifest and Android APK pre-publication gate. Nothing publishes unless it appears here.

t-deck-plus.note: Populate only after the real firmware/OTA inspection in docs/REALITY_RECONCILIATION.md is done; empty list means no revision is accepted yet.

t-watch-ultra.note: Same rule as t-deck-plus: an empty revision list accepts nothing.

ota.key_note: No OTA signing key is enrolled. Enrolment requires the public key file (control/keys/<id>.pub.pem), a not_after date and a review; private keys never enter this repository and never touch the VPS.

apk.cert_note: Empty list means no APK release can pass: key continuity has to be pinned from a real signed build, and no signed build exists yet (D6).
